versions.changelog:
Initial release of the schedule-post skill for BulkPublish MCP.

- Enables creation, scheduling, and publishing of social media posts across multiple platforms.
- Supports post formats including text, media, threads, and per-platform type overrides (e.g., reels, stories).
- Allows team approval workflows, including holding posts for review and specifying post-approval publishing behavior.
- Includes link tracking overrides with detailed behavior across plans and platforms.
- Thorough documentation of parameters and approval flow for robust post scheduling and management.
